name: Zaccheus
headline: Life on do-not-disturb.
subhead: The gym, the food, the skin and the discipline underneath all of it — written down in one place, and me in the chat while you build it.

inside.title: The skin routine, in order
inside.text:
Morning and night. What I use, what order it goes in, and how long to wait between steps.
No guessing, and no ten-step routine for the sake of it — just the order, which is the part nobody writes down.

inside.title: The inside half
inside.text:
Your skin is a reflection of how you treat the inside of your body. That is the whole thing I say, so this is where I show it.
What I eat, what I drink, what I cut, and what changed first when I did — without pretending there is one fix that works on everyone.

inside.title: My training week
inside.text:
The actual sessions, not the highlights. What I do in the gym, in order, with the sets and the reps.
Plus the version for the weeks you only make it twice, because those weeks come.

inside.title: The chat, and I'm in it
inside.text:
Ask me anything. What to swap, why you broke out this week, whether to train through it.
The questions you'd send me in a DM, except everyone gets to read the answer.

inside.title: Live Q&A
inside.text:
Got a question? Drop it in the community anytime during the week, and I’ll answer it live. Your question could be the one we dive into next.
No more getting lost in DMs. Just real answers, straight from me to you.

inside.title: Sundays
inside.text:
The posts I put up on a Sunday, except in here we can actually talk about them.
Not a sermon. Just the part where keeping your word to yourself is the same muscle either way.

inside.title: The month it stops working
inside.text:
A bad stretch of skin, a week you fall off, a month where nothing moves.
That is when people quit for good, and that is exactly what this is for.

inside.title: Everyone's running the same thing
inside.text:
Not a feed of strangers with perfect skin and a sponsorship. People at week two, week nine, week thirty, posting what changed and what didn’t.
It is a lot harder to quit in week three when you can see someone who is six weeks ahead of where you are.

inside.title: People you’d never have met
inside.text:
Same goals, same routine, same reason for being here — and not everyone has someone in their life they can talk to about any of it.
In here that is the normal conversation instead of the weird one.

inside.title: Challenges we start together
inside.text:
Same starting line, your own progress. Everyone begins on the same day, and the board counts both the pounds lost and the percent of your own bodyweight.
So whoever you are and wherever you started, you’re actually in it.

lockedLine: Whatever you join at is what you pay for as long as you stay. It goes up for the people who come later, not for you.
